video.timeline.evidence: [director·codex] 逐拍核对图1：①0–0.5秒：站定与远处敌群发生，约22米距离无法确认。②0.5–2.0秒：敌群接近发生，9米位移及6米/秒无法确认。③2.0–2.5秒：抬臂发生，但2.25秒（第2行第2格）手前出现向敌侧延伸的橙色火束，偏离两指指地、指尖不射出东西。④2.5–3.0秒：地面发亮发生，领头急刹外跳、后两只撞上并瞪她的完整动作缺乏可辨证据。⑤3.0–3.8秒：火柱发生，但三只同时掀飞并立即出现头顶旋涡无法确认。⑥3.8–4.5秒：错，4.00、4.25秒仍有高火柱，4.50秒仍有明显竖直火焰及空中敌兵，未按时完成塌落与三只落地。⑦4.5–6.5秒：趴地幸存者及蓝白旋涡发生，但两只仰躺死亡的姿态无法逐只确认。⑧6.5–7.2秒：错，7.25秒仍在持火准备，7.50秒出手，7.75秒才见目标身上爆光。⑨7.2–8.5秒：后仰、扬臂、倒地发生，主要在8.00–8.50秒。⑩8.5–10.5秒：遗骸露骨发生，干缩、龟裂、逐片剥落的顺序无法确认。⑪10.5–13秒：有手靠近嘴及随后挥手，但11.75秒仍有新手势；拼图止于12.75秒，最后两秒稳定及13秒终点无法确认。

video.scale.evidence: [director·codex] 图1第2行第2–3格（2.25–2.50秒）食尸鬼仍处于更远景深且屈身奔跑；第4行（6.00–7.75秒）近处幸存者为趴伏姿态。没有可用于可靠比较的同景深直立食尸鬼与施法者，无法确认1.80米对1.78米的近等高关系，也无法确认四足奔跑时背高只到她腰部。

video.head_tail.evidence: [director·codex] 图1第1行（0–1.75秒）施法者基本站定，只有规格允许的掌心预备火焰，未见地面攻击特效；尾段遗骸可见。但第6行第7–8格至第7行第1格（11.50–12.00秒）手臂仍变换姿势，至12.75秒不足连续两秒稳定站姿，尾段要求不通过。

video.agency.evidence: [秀逗魔导士·codex] 图1：0–1.75秒我站稳面对来敌，掌中持火；2.0–2.5秒在敌人尚未贴身时抬臂指向前方，3.0秒火柱出现，出手时机合理。5.0–7.75秒面对倒地且带眩晕圈的剩余目标，我重新蓄火并甩手补击；8.5秒后解除攻击姿态，10.5–12.75秒完成吹指尖、收手。可见动作有备战、攻击、补击和确认结束的目的，未见明确的无故空等。；[食尸鬼·claude] Most of my behaviour makes sense from my side. From 0.0 to 2.25 s (rows 1–2) the three of us charge at her along the road without stopping, growing steadily larger. From 3.0 to 4.75 s we are caught in the fire column and react by flailing and being thrown. From 5.0 to 7.5 s the stunned one is down on all fours at the edge of the scorched patch, trembling and unable to get up. At 7.75 s the fireball hits it, and from 8.0 to 8.5 s it falls on its back. The beat I can't confirm is 2.5–3.0 s, where the spec has us notice the glowing circle, brake hard and look up at her. At 2.5 and 2.75 s (row 2, cells 3–4) the three of us stand side by side inside the glowing patch in almost the same pose. I can't see the leader dip its head to look at the circle, brake or try to jump out, or the two behind crash into it. It looks more like we stopped and waited for the fire than reacted to the danger. At this resolution I can't rule out a slight brake, so I'm marking it fail.

video.gaze.evidence: [秀逗魔导士·codex] 图1中我的头部大体朝画右，但无法确认全程锁定目标：第三行第5–8格（5.0–5.75秒）目标已落到右下方，我是否随之下移视线看不清；第四行第3–6格（6.5–7.25秒）火焰举到脸旁，也无法分辨我是在看掌中火还是地上的目标。拼图面部细节不足，不能据头部大方向判定眼神始终跟随敌人；按拿不准即fail判定。；[食尸鬼·claude] While we charge from 0.0 to 1.75 s (row 1), we are tiny figures and I can't tell which way our faces point. From 2.0 to 2.75 s (row 2, cells 1–4) our heads look mostly frontal toward the camera, not clearly turned left toward her. I can't confirm that our eyes stay locked on her, or that we look up and glare at her at 2.5–3.0 s. At 4.75 s (row 3, cell 4) one of us stands upright in the fire, arms spread and facing the camera head-on. That frame counts as the controlled exception for being thrown, but it adds to the feeling of facing the lens. From 5.0 to 7.5 s the stunned one is also controlled, so it's excluded from this check. The charge frames are too small to verify our gaze, so I'm judging it fail.

video.readability.evidence: [audience·claude] Who casts and who gets hit is clear. The red-robed mage holds a flame from 0.0s to 2.0s while 3–4 four-legged monsters approach. At 2.25s she throws a fireball, at 2.5–2.75s a line of fire runs along the ground under the monsters, and from 3.0s to 4.5s a big column of fire hits them and throws them into the air. What happens to them is not clear. From 5.0s to 7.25s they lie on the ground with small blue marks over them, so they could be stunned or dead. At 7.5–7.75s a second fireball hits one of them, and at 8.0–8.5s that one rolls and kicks. From 8.75s to 10.0s, with nothing visible causing it, all of them turn into piles of white bones that stay until 12.75s. A first-time viewer can't tell whether the result is 'stunned' or 'burned to skeletons'. It's also unclear whether the fire column at 3.0s is the fireball from her hand or a separate skill coming down from the sky.

video.fidelity.evidence: [fidelity·codex] 图2锁定的峰值是橙红、黄白芯的地涌火柱，同时将三只食尸鬼掀至半空，三只头顶均有浅蓝白旋涡圈。图1第2行第6–7格（3.25、3.50秒）火柱已达强盛状态，三只仍挤在柱底附近，未呈现锁定的三只同时腾空及头顶眩晕圈；到第3行第3–4格（4.50、4.75秒）火柱收缩时才明显出现掀飞姿态，命中效果与峰值错位。此外，第2行第2格（2.25秒）可见手部向目标方向延伸的橙亮火束，与规格要求的“指尖不射出任何东西，火从地下来”不符。火柱主色接近，但施法与命中表现不通过。

video.attack_contact.evidence: [director·codex] 图1第2行第3–5格（2.50–3.00秒）敌群进入发亮地面，随后火柱与敌群身体重叠；第3行第3–4格（4.50–4.75秒）可见被掀飞的身体。第4行第8格（7.75秒）幸存者上躯干出现橙白命中爆光，紧接第5行第1–3格（8.00–8.50秒）后仰、扬臂并倒地，两次攻击均有接触及受击反应。

video.stun_visible.evidence: [audience·claude] Small blue swirl marks appear over the monsters' heads from about 3.0s (inside the fire) to about 7.5s, and are clearest at 5.25–7.25s. But the monsters are lying flat during that time (5.0–7.25s), so it looks like they were knocked down or killed, not stunned where they stand. The swirls are tiny in the grid cells and easy to miss. At 8.0–8.5s the monster hit by the second fireball is still clearly rolling and kicking, so it isn't 'unable to act'. From 8.75s on, the swirls fade and the bodies turn into bones, so the stun has no clear end point. A viewer can't tell how long it lasted or whether these units were stunned or just dead.

video.attack_tempo.evidence: [director·codex] 图1第4行第3–6格（6.50、6.75、7.00、7.25秒）施法者持续举着掌心火焰，姿态变化小；第7格（7.50秒）才甩出，第8格（7.75秒）命中。准备至命中约1.25秒，连续四格持火等待，未达到规格6.5–7.2秒内干脆甩手并命中的节奏。
